asset.description: Key into the top-level `assets` registry. Optional for asset-less parkour markers (`parkour.entities`).
asset.markdownDescription: Key into the top-level `assets` registry. Optional for asset-less parkour markers (`parkour.entities`).

rotation.description: Euler rotation in radians, YXZ order. Default: [0, 0, 0]
rotation.markdownDescription: Euler rotation in radians, YXZ order. Default: [0, 0, 0]

userData.description: Passed through to object.userData; also checked for flags like `nocollide`
userData.markdownDescription: Passed through to object.userData; also checked for flags like `nocollide`

material.description: Key into the top-level `materials` registry. All meshes in this object get this material.
material.markdownDescription: Key into the top-level `materials` registry. All meshes in this object get this material.

inputs.description:
Per-object overrides for the asset's `input_*` control values (sparse; merged over the
asset-level `inputs`). Only valid on geoscript / geotoyComposition assets. Placements with
distinct merged inputs resolve to distinct baked variants of the asset.
inputs.markdownDescription:
Per-object overrides for the asset's `input_*` control values (sparse; merged over the
asset-level `inputs`). Only valid on geoscript / geotoyComposition assets. Placements with
distinct merged inputs resolve to distinct baked variants of the asset.

anyOf.description:
Accepts a color as either a plain integer (e.g. 0x303030 → 3158064) or a
CSS-style 6-digit hex string (e.g. "#303030").  No transform here; callers
that need an integer must run `normalizeRawDefColors`.
anyOf.markdownDescription:
Accepts a color as either a plain integer (e.g. 0x303030 → 3158064) or a
CSS-style 6-digit hex string (e.g. "#303030").  No transform here; callers
that need an integer must run `normalizeRawDefColors`.

value.description:
A parametric input value injected into a geoscript program / composition at bake, keyed by the
`input_*` control's name. Mirrors the `input_*` builtins; `color` accepts an `[r,g,b]` 0..1 triple,
an int (0xRRGGBB), or a "#rrggbb" hex string (the latter two normalized to a 0..1 triple).
value.markdownDescription:
A parametric input value injected into a geoscript program / composition at bake, keyed by the
`input_*` control's name. Mirrors the `input_*` builtins; `color` accepts an `[r,g,b]` 0..1 triple,
an int (0xRRGGBB), or a "#rrggbb" hex string (the latter two normalized to a 0..1 triple).

value.description: 1 element for scalar ramps, 3 (linear RGB) for color ramps.
value.markdownDescription: 1 element for scalar ramps, 3 (linear RGB) for color ramps.

value.description:
`vec3`/`transform` override a `gizmo(...)`/`gizmo_transform(...)` handle rather than an
`input_*` control. Keys are bare handle names, or `module/handle`-qualified to target one
composition node when the bare name is ambiguous.
value.markdownDescription:
`vec3`/`transform` override a `gizmo(...)`/`gizmo_transform(...)` handle rather than an
`input_*` control. Keys are bare handle names, or `module/handle`-qualified to target one
composition node when the bare name is ambiguous.

nocollide.description: If true, this object will not be registered in the collision world
nocollide.markdownDescription: If true, this object will not be registered in the collision world

nonPermeable.description:
Overrides the material-level `nonPermeable` flag for this object.
When true, the camera hard-snaps rather than dithering through it.
When false, disables non-permeable behavior even if the material sets it.
When absent, the material's own flag is used.
nonPermeable.markdownDescription:
Overrides the material-level `nonPermeable` flag for this object.
When true, the camera hard-snaps rather than dithering through it.
When false, disables non-permeable behavior even if the material sets it.
When absent, the material's own flag is used.

parkour.description: Parkour-specific metadata: marks this object as a checkpoint or win zone.
parkour.markdownDescription: Parkour-specific metadata: marks this object as a checkpoint or win zone.

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint index (0, 1, 2…). Makes this object a mid-level respawn checkpoint.
checkpoint.markdownDescription: Checkpoint index (0, 1, 2…). Makes this object a mid-level respawn checkpoint.

win.description: If true, reaching this object ends the run.
win.markdownDescription: If true, reaching this object ends the run.

boostSurface.description: Per-object boost-surface config; overrides any material-level config on the same object.
boostSurface.markdownDescription: Per-object boost-surface config; overrides any material-level config on the same object.

targetSpeed.description: Ground walk-speed override while the aux key is held and the player stands on this surface.
targetSpeed.markdownDescription: Ground walk-speed override while the aux key is held and the player stands on this surface.

jumpRetention.description: 0..1; fraction of live walk velocity locked into external vel on jump from this surface.
jumpRetention.markdownDescription: 0..1; fraction of live walk velocity locked into external vel on jump from this surface.

rampUpSeconds.description:
Seconds to ramp from base walk speed up to `targetSpeed` after the aux key arms boost.
Curve is a soft-knee smoothstep² (slow start, fast finish, soft top).  Default 0 = snap.
rampUpSeconds.markdownDescription:
Seconds to ramp from base walk speed up to `targetSpeed` after the aux key arms boost.
Curve is a soft-knee smoothstep² (slow start, fast finish, soft top).  Default 0 = snap.

followSurfaceSlope.description:
If true (default), boost jump-retention launches along the floor's tangent plane (capped
at ±45°) instead of purely horizontally — so a ramped strip launches you up the ramp.
followSurfaceSlope.markdownDescription:
If true (default), boost jump-retention launches along the floor's tangent plane (capped
at ±45°) instead of purely horizontally — so a ramped strip launches you up the ramp.

climb.description: Per-object climbability config; overrides any material-level config on the same object.
climb.markdownDescription: Per-object climbability config; overrides any material-level config on the same object.

maxClimbAngle.description:
Max slope angle (radians) the player can stand on. Steeper surfaces never ground the
player — they slide down under gravity — and jumps off them are denied.
maxClimbAngle.markdownDescription:
Max slope angle (radians) the player can stand on. Steeper surfaces never ground the
player — they slide down under gravity — and jumps off them are denied.

slideMinAngle.description:
Surface angle (radians) at which downhill sliding begins while still grounded. Can
enable sliding on this surface even when the scene has no global `slopeSlide`.
slideMinAngle.markdownDescription:
Surface angle (radians) at which downhill sliding begins while still grounded. Can
enable sliding on this surface even when the scene has no global `slopeSlide`.

slideMaxSpeed.description: Peak downhill slide speed (units/sec), reached at `maxClimbAngle`.
slideMaxSpeed.markdownDescription: Peak downhill slide speed (units/sec), reached at `maxClimbAngle`.

entities.description: Standalone trigger entities (jump pads, boost zones, dash tokens) at this object's transform.
entities.markdownDescription: Standalone trigger entities (jump pads, boost zones, dash tokens) at this object's transform.

collider.description: Collider built from the asset mesh. Default: 'trimesh' (exact, concave-ok); others are cheaper approximations.
collider.markdownDescription: Collider built from the asset mesh. Default: 'trimesh' (exact, concave-ok); others are cheaper approximations.

margin.description: trimesh only: uniform inflation of the sensor volume. Default: 0
margin.markdownDescription: trimesh only: uniform inflation of the sensor volume. Default: 0

region.description:
Trigger volume for a parkour entity, placed at the owning object's world transform. `box`/`sphere`
are explicit primitives sized in world units. `mesh` reuses the object's own asset mesh (full world
transform, incl. scale), so the trigger matches a cylindrical/custom asset — requires an `asset`.
region.markdownDescription:
Trigger volume for a parkour entity, placed at the owning object's world transform. `box`/`sphere`
are explicit primitives sized in world units. `mesh` reuses the object's own asset mesh (full world
transform, incl. scale), so the trigger matches a cylindrical/custom asset — requires an `asset`.

direction.description:
World-space launch direction, or `'matchMeshRotation'` to rotate the pad's local +Y by the
object's world rotation (so tilting the mesh tilts the launch). Default: [0, 1, 0]
direction.markdownDescription:
World-space launch direction, or `'matchMeshRotation'` to rotate the pad's local +Y by the
object's world rotation (so tilting the mesh tilts the launch). Default: [0, 1, 0]

oneOf.description: Launches the player on contact. `direction` is world-space (default straight up).
oneOf.markdownDescription: Launches the player on contact. `direction` is world-space (default straight up).

Marks a dash-token spawn point. Realized by the parkour subsystem (not the loader): the
animated token + collect ghost are spawned at the object's world position, so `asset` may be
omitted and no static mesh/collision is created.
